rules.scope: Both endpoints intersect official Manhattan borough boundary
rules.timezone: Timestamps interpreted as NYC local wall time, without conversion from UTC
rules.membership: Unknown categories retained for total/space views, excluded only from Q2
rules.arrivals: End-time date determines arrival day type; only September-start cohort available; incoming August trips are not present
rules.coordinates: Station locations are endpoint-frequency-weighted means of eligible endpoint coordinates
rules.duration: Positive duration required; no arbitrary upper-duration filter
